# Markdown markup reference

Fluent extensions declared by the `Aprillz.MewUI.Markdown` package.

### MarkdownPresenter

Receiver: `MarkdownPresenter` and derived types (`where T : MarkdownPresenter`).

| Method | Sets | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `BaseUri(Uri value)` | `BaseUri` | Sets the base URI used for relative resources without authorizing access. |
| `ImageResolver(IMarkdownImageResolver value)` | `ImageResolver` | Sets the image resolver; null displays alternative text without I/O. |
| `IsSelectionEnabled(bool value = true)` | `IsSelectionEnabled` | Sets whether text can be selected with the mouse and keyboard. |
| `Markdown(string value)` | `Markdown` | Sets the Markdown source; equal values preserve the current tree. |
| `MarkdownTheme(MarkdownTheme value)` | `MarkdownTheme` | Sets document metrics and color overrides without reparsing. |
| `OnCopying(Action<MarkdownCopyingEventArgs> handler)` | `event Copying` | Subscribes handler to Copying. Occurs before the selected text is written to the clipboard; a handler may replace the text or cancel the copy. |
| `OnLinkRequested(Action<MarkdownLinkRequestedEventArgs> handler)` | `event LinkRequested` | Subscribes handler to LinkRequested. Occurs when a link is activated, for the host to handle; no external navigation occurs automatically. |
| `OnParseFailed(Action<Exception> handler)` | `event ParseFailed` | Subscribes handler to ParseFailed. Occurs when a background parse fails; the previous document stays displayed. |
| `OnSelectionChanged(Action handler)` | `event SelectionChanged` | Subscribes handler to SelectionChanged. Occurs when the selection changes, including when it is cleared. |
| `Options(MarkdownOptions value)` | `Options` | Sets immutable parsing options. |
| `ParseDelay(TimeSpan value)` | `ParseDelay` | Sets the debounce delay after which source changes parse on a worker thread; zero parses synchronously on the UI thread. |
| `Renderers(MarkdownRenderers value)` | `Renderers` | Sets custom renderers consulted before the default presentation; assign a configured instance. |
| `WithCodeBlockFactory(Func<string, string, FrameworkElement> factory)` | `CodeBlockFactory` | Sets CodeBlockFactory and returns the control. |
